note.turn: the records between two user records that are neither a tool result, a Stop hook feedback nor meta. Its final message is the last assistant text with no tool call after it; a Stop feedback refusing the turn cancels the text before it.
note.founder_message: a user record that is not meta, a tool result or a Stop feedback, and does not open with a <command-, <local-command, <task-notification, <system-reminder, <bash- or <user-memory wrapper, "Caveat:", "[Request interrupted" or a compaction summary.
